source.method: All eleven original tests across V148/V149/V153 default Golden consumers run unchanged. Observe eight complete simulate returns and exact config/options, enforce per-consumer call order, and require all six compatibility calls and two native calls byte-identical before deduplicating into two full cases. No current output is stripped/relabelled; native and compatibility policies stay distinct.
